steps.label: Judicial Composition
steps.caption: Division bench combines judicial member and accountant member.

steps.label: Fact Finding Finality
steps.caption: Findings of fact recorded by tribunal are conclusive and binding.

steps.label: Special Bench Power
steps.caption: President constitutes larger bench to resolve coordinate conflicts.

steps.label: Independent Forum
steps.caption: Tribunal functions under ministry of law guaranteeing judicial neutrality.

steps.label: Form Thirty Six
steps.caption: Appellant files electronic memorandum of appeal within sixty days.

steps.label: Graduated Filing Fee
steps.caption: Fee scales with assessed income subject to statutory maximum cap.

steps.label: Grounds Formulation
steps.caption: Counsel drafts distinct grounds challenging specific legal additions.

steps.label: Cross Objections
steps.caption: Respondent files cross objections in form thirty six A within thirty days.

steps.label: Disputed Liability
steps.caption: Assessee faces coercive recovery under statutory demand notice.

steps.label: Twenty Percent Deposit
steps.caption: Assessee deposits statutory twenty percent into central tax treasury.

steps.label: Stay Application
steps.caption: Counsel presents prima facie case and balance of convenience.

steps.label: Constitutional Shield
steps.caption: Stay continues beyond statutory period if delay is not from assessee.

steps.label: Patent Mistake Discovery
steps.caption: Counsel identifies obvious error apparent from the judicial record.

steps.label: Six Month Limitation
steps.caption: Application must be submitted within six months from order month end.

steps.label: Bench Listing
steps.caption: Specific division bench that passed order considers rectification memo.

steps.label: Operative Amendment
steps.caption: Tribunal corrects computational error or recalls order for rehearing.

steps.label: Limitation Tracking
steps.caption: System alerts counsel to sixty day deadline from order communication.

steps.label: Fee Calculation
steps.caption: Engine computes graduated tribunal fee based on assessed corporate income.

steps.label: Stay Monitor
steps.caption: Module tracks elapsed stay duration and flags constitutional extension.

steps.label: Precedent Indexing
steps.caption: Knowledge base organizes jurisdictional high court binding authorities.
